devise: Authentication: adds current_user helper, authenticate_user! before_action, and columns: encrypted_password, reset_password_token, reset_password_sent_at, remember_created_at, sign_in_count, current_sign_in_at, last_sign_in_at, current_sign_in_ip, last_sign_in_ip, confirmation_token, confirmed_at, confirmation_sent_at, unconfirmed_email, failed_attempts, unlock_token, locked_at
pundit: Authorization: adds policy classes in app/policies/, authorize helper, policy_scope helper, and UserPolicy class convention
cancancan: Authorization: adds Ability class in app/models/ability.rb, can?/cannot? helpers, authorize_resource/load_and_authorize_resource before_action
sidekiq: Background jobs: adds perform_async class method, perform_in, perform_at. Workers in app/workers/ inherit from ApplicationJob or include Sidekiq::Worker
carrierwave: File uploads: adds mount_uploader macro, uploader classes in app/uploaders/. Columns: avatar (string), avatar_tmp (string)
active_storage: File attachments (Rails built-in): adds has_one_attached/has_many_attached macros. No extra columns — uses active_storage_blobs and active_storage_attachments tables
ransack: Search/filter: adds ransack(params) class method, result method, and ransackable_attributes. Used with @q = Model.ransack(params[:q])
kaminari: Pagination: adds page(n).per(m) scopes, total_pages, current_page. View helpers: paginate(@collection)
will_paginate: Pagination: adds paginate(page:, per_page:) scope. View helpers: will_paginate(@collection)
paranoia: Soft delete: adds acts_as_paranoid macro, deleted_at column, destroy soft-deletes, really_destroy! hard-deletes, with_deleted scope
acts_as_taggable_on: Tagging: adds acts_as_taggable_on macro, tag_list attribute, tagged_with scope. Tables: tags, taggings
scenic: Database views: adds create_view migration helper. Views defined in db/views/
rolify: Roles: adds resourcify/rolify macros, has_role?/add_role methods. Tables: roles, users_roles
friendlyid: Slug URLs: adds extend FriendlyId, friendly_id :name, use: :slugged macro. Adds slug column
counter_culture: Counter caches: adds counter_culture macro for maintaining denormalized counts
paper_trail: Versioning/audit: adds has_paper_trail macro, versions association. Table: versions
money_rails: Currency: adds monetize macro, Money objects. Columns: *_cents (integer) + *_currency (string)
ancestry: Tree structure: adds has_ancestry macro, ancestors/descendants/children scopes. Column: ancestry (string)
acts_as_list: Ordering: adds acts_as_list macro, move_higher/move_lower methods. Column: position (integer)
geocoder: Geocoding: adds geocoded_by/reverse_geocoded_by macros. Columns: latitude (float), longitude (float)
